name: MenuNavigation
description: PC 端侧边菜单导航。支持单层级、多层级、多层级加搜索和公共头部产品菜单四种形态；叶子项维护唯一选中态，父项只负责单一展开，搜索仅派发输入事件。

variants.name: single-level
variants.whenToUse: PC250px侧栏只有同级叶子入口。
variants.whenNotToUse: 需要子层级、288px精确调用或页面滚动。
variants.usage: PC250px侧栏只有同级叶子入口。

variants.name: multi-level
variants.whenToUse: PC288px侧栏有一级父项和二级叶子。
variants.whenNotToUse: 三级层级、250px调用或自动过滤。
variants.usage: PC288px侧栏有一级父项和二级叶子。

variants.name: multi-level-search
variants.whenToUse: 250px PC二级菜单，配真实42px搜索部件，向宿主发出查询意图。
variants.whenNotToUse: 自动生成搜索结果、未接业务的数据过滤、三级导航或移动端。
variants.usage: 250px PC二级菜单，配真实42px搜索部件，向宿主发出查询意图。

variants.name: public-header
variants.whenToUse: 固定英文Header中All Products的240px产品菜单子组件维护与调用。
variants.whenNotToUse: 普通页面侧栏、整个多栏MegaMenu或替换固定Header。
variants.usage: 真实嵌入Navigation/header；叶节点发原有菜单选择事件，路由仍由宿主处理。

title.description: 标准三种变体可选的 16px/24px SemiBold 标题；public-header 不使用。

itemLabel.description: 完整展示，允许自然换行，禁止省略和截断。

itemIcon.description: public-header 产品项使用的本地 22×22px SVG。

search.description: 仅 multi-level-search 使用的原生 input[type=search]。

commonProperties.element: nav > optional title/search + ul > li > button；父项通过 aria-expanded/aria-controls 控制子 ul[hidden]
commonProperties.selection: 一级或二级叶子项在当前组件内唯一 selected；父项只展开/收起
commonProperties.keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown 在可见项间移动；Home/End 到首尾；Enter/Space 使用原生按钮激活；Escape 收起当前层级并回到父项
commonProperties.events: 叶子选择派发 ds:menu-navigation-change；搜索输入派发 ds:menu-navigation-search；父项展开派发 ds:menu-navigation-toggle

usageGuidelines: 页面侧栏同级入口使用 single-level；具有父子层级时使用 multi-level；只有确有搜索输入时使用 multi-level-search；三种标准侧栏变体必须保留灰色底上/下 20px、左侧 15px 的留白，公共头部产品菜单不使用这组侧栏留白；既有 Navigation/header 的产品菜单使用 public-header。锚点目录、内容标签页、通用折叠内容和树形层级分别使用 AnchorNav、Tab、Collapse 和 Tree Navigation，不得仅因视觉相近互相替代。
responsiveRules: 当前版本只实现和验收 PC desktop，不生成 Tablet/Mobile 断点、重排或交互。
single-level、multi-level、multi-level-search 使用同一 DOM 的 288px 或 250px 宽度修饰；public-header 仅使用 240px。
标准三种变体 sticky top 为 16px；public-header 不 sticky。
M 端已决定 deferred；重新触发条件是后续补充 M 端代码并明确要求实现。

mutuallyExclusiveWith.reason: AnchorNav 对应页内 section 定位；MenuNavigation 管理侧栏菜单的选中或层级展开。

hardRules.title: 父项只展开，叶子项唯一选中
hardRules.description: 层级 disclosure 与 selection 必须分离。

parent.click = toggleOnly
parent.selected = false
expandedParent.max = 1
leaf.selected.max = 1
childSelection.keepParentExpanded = true

identity.rule: Root nav/data-menu-navigation, safe native buttons with distinct data-values, globally unique panel IDs paired with aria-controls. At most one parent open and one visible selected leaf. Regenerate panel IDs for copies; never copy data-menu-navigation-ready or runtime tabindex.
identity.labelRule: menuContent edits actual labels/value identities, optional title, search placeholder/name and paired panel IDs while retaining required structure and valid state. Product icons stay registered and matched to product values.

behavior.initialization: FSMenuNavigation.initialize/initializeAll are actual APIs for authored dynamically inserted menus; data-menu-navigation-ready guards repeats. Do not copy initialized DOM.
behavior.selection: Leaf selection is unique per root; change detail=value/label. Parent toggles single-open panels and emits toggle detail=expanded/value/label.
behavior.focusCorrection: Current opt-in runtime moves the tab stop to an activated parent, including after closing selected descendants. Initial focus only chooses visible items. Legacy runtime is unchanged for historical pages.
behavior.keyboard: ArrowUp/Down wrap through visible panel items; Home/End first/last; Escape closes current panel and focuses parent. Enter/Space rely on native button activation; actual browser validation pending.
behavior.search: Search input emits query only; no internal filtering, highlight or auto-expand. Host hidden-li filtering is outside current keyboard visibility logic.
behavior.business: Buttons are local controls. Host listens to events; component does not open links, submit forms or call APIs.
behavior.publicHeader: Source240px product menu is now actually embedded in the fixed English Navigation/header; original leaf events and keyboard behavior retained. Not an arbitrary sidebar/MegaMenu.
behavior.nativeStateGuard: Native disabled items and fieldsets block synthetic click/keyboard/search; roving focus skips disabled items and restores one enabled tab stop. Existing selected/open state preserved, no new business filtering.
behavior.composition: Search composition intermediate input emits no query callback. A changed committed query emits once on compositionend; its identical following input is suppressed once. Ordinary input callbacks remain; unavailable completion emits nothing. No filtering, request or business submission; actual browser IME/event ordering pending.
behavior.atomStates: Current ordinary menu atoms: Hover leaf red text-width indicator; parent Hover/Press has no selection indicator. Actual atom white states retained where norm gray conflicts. Public-header source pending.
behavior.searchSourceBoundary: PC250px搜索菜单现引用Input/menu-search42私有部件与真实IconButton；input/composition继续原查询语义，Enter/搜索按钮补发submitted查询意图。原独立搜索框旧来源、业务过滤及M端范围分开，不混作本次准入。
